findingDetails.title: The duplicate-command guard cannot withhold a command
findingDetails.claim: alreadyOffered is built from the input rows and never extended inside the map, and the branch that withholds a duplicate spreads ...recommendation first, keeping the row's existing command, policy and typed fields.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The set is written in one loop and read in another with no other writer; the false branch keeps prior fields by construction.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Read the whole function and both branches, then the cache-hit callers at :556 and :628 which re-enrich a stored output; checked whether either branch strips command, policy or typed, and neither does.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The guard may be intended only to avoid a second policy lookup, in which case the comment is wrong rather than the code; the head still prints one command per row either way.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Withdraw if a caller relies on the false branch to strip a command, or if the duplicate case is shown unreachable by construction.
